notes: §2002:7.2.10.2 SR14 forms EVALUATE operands per 2002 7.2.5: 31-digit fixed-point literals are accepted and evaluated in 32-digit standard arithmetic (§2002:7.2.5.2 GR1), so 10^30*100+9-10^30*100 selects WHEN 0 and 2/3*3 THRU 10/4-1 holds 1. Exponentiation (§2002:7.2.5.1 SR1a) and division by zero (SR1c) are refused (g2ev20n1, g2ev20n2, COBOL1619). Matched at --std 2002.
